alarm_query: Messages belong here when the user wants to check the existence, time, recurrence, description, or number of configured alarms.
alarm_remove: Messages belong here when the user wants to cancel, disable, or delete one or more alarms rather than merely silence a currently playing sound.
alarm_set: Messages belong here when the user wants to create an alarm or change the time or date of an existing alarm.
audio_volume_down: Messages belong here when the user wants the device or media volume reduced without fully muting it.
audio_volume_mute: Messages belong here when the user wants all sound or spoken notifications temporarily or indefinitely silenced.
audio_volume_other: Messages belong here when the user wants general audio settings or sound adjustments without specifying louder, quieter, or muted output.
audio_volume_up: Messages belong here when the user wants the device or media volume increased or wants muted audio restored.
calendar_query: Messages belong here when the user wants to view, check, or confirm calendar events, appointments, birthdays, or calendar reminders.
calendar_remove: Messages belong here when the user wants to delete one or more calendar events or clear part or all of a calendar.
calendar_set: Messages belong here when the user wants to create a calendar event, appointment, birthday entry, or event-related reminder.
cooking_query: Messages belong here when the user wants meal ideas, cooking advice, ingredient substitutions, or help choosing what to prepare.
cooking_recipe: Messages belong here when the user wants a recipe, preparation method, cooking time, or ingredient quantity for a particular food.
datetime_convert: Messages belong here when the user wants to convert a time between time zones or change the device's configured time zone.
datetime_query: Messages belong here when the user wants the current or relative date or the current time in a particular place or time zone.
email_addcontact: Messages belong here when the user wants to save an email address as a new contact.
email_query: Messages belong here when the user wants to find, read, or check the status of received email messages.
email_querycontact: Messages belong here when the user wants to find or retrieve a person's saved contact details rather than inspect email content.
email_sendemail: Messages belong here when the user wants to compose, send, reply to, or forward an email.
general_greet: Messages belong here when the user is greeting the assistant or making brief social small talk about how it is doing.
general_joke: Messages belong here when the user wants to hear a joke or something intentionally funny.
general_quirky: Messages belong here when the user makes an unusual, open-ended, personal, or conversational request that does not fit a more specific task category.
iot_cleaning: Messages belong here when the user wants a robotic vacuum or other connected cleaning device to start cleaning now or at a specified time.
iot_coffee: Messages belong here when the user wants a connected coffee machine to prepare coffee now or on a schedule.
iot_hue_lightchange: Messages belong here when the user wants to change a smart light's color, color temperature, or other specific lighting appearance.
iot_hue_lightdim: Messages belong here when the user wants smart lights made dimmer without explicitly switching them off.
iot_hue_lightoff: Messages belong here when the user wants one or more smart lights switched off.
iot_hue_lighton: Messages belong here when the user wants one or more smart lights switched on.
iot_hue_lightup: Messages belong here when the user wants already available smart lighting made brighter or set to maximum brightness.
iot_wemo_off: Messages belong here when the user wants a smart plug or an appliance controlled through one switched off.
iot_wemo_on: Messages belong here when the user wants a smart plug or an appliance controlled through one switched on.
lists_createoradd: Messages belong here when the user wants to create a list or add an item to an existing list.
lists_query: Messages belong here when the user wants to know which lists exist or what items a list contains.
lists_remove: Messages belong here when the user wants to remove list items, delete a list, or clear a list.
music_dislikeness: Messages belong here when the user expresses dislike for a song or asks the assistant to remember not to play it again.
music_likeness: Messages belong here when the user expresses approval of music or wants a positive song rating or preference saved.
music_query: Messages belong here when the user wants information about a song, such as its title, performer, writer, popularity, or listening history.
music_settings: Messages belong here when the user wants to change music playback behavior or controls such as shuffle, repeat, skipping, or player settings.
news_query: Messages belong here when the user wants current news, headlines, or updates about a news topic.
play_audiobook: Messages belong here when the user wants to start, resume, or navigate playback of an audiobook.
play_game: Messages belong here when the user wants to open, play, or participate in a game.
play_music: Messages belong here when the user wants music by a chosen artist, song, album, genre, or era to begin or resume playing.
play_podcasts: Messages belong here when the user wants to start a podcast or navigate between podcast episodes.
play_radio: Messages belong here when the user wants to start radio playback or select a radio station, frequency, or channel.
qa_currency: Messages belong here when the user wants an exchange rate between currencies.
qa_definition: Messages belong here when the user wants the meaning, definition, description, or explanation of a concept or thing.
qa_factoid: Messages belong here when the user wants a specific factual answer that is not covered by a more specialized information label.
qa_maths: Messages belong here when the user wants a calculation performed or a mathematical formula or procedure explained.
qa_stock: Messages belong here when the user wants a company's current stock price, value, or recent market movement.
recommendation_events: Messages belong here when the user wants to discover or receive recommendations for public events or activities in a place or time period.
recommendation_locations: Messages belong here when the user wants to find or receive recommendations for nearby businesses, restaurants, shops, or other places.
recommendation_movies: Messages belong here when the user wants movie recommendations or information about films currently showing at cinemas.
social_post: Messages belong here when the user wants to publish a social-media post, status update, tweet, complaint, or message to an organization.
social_query: Messages belong here when the user wants to check social-media posts, updates, trends, or activity.
takeaway_order: Messages belong here when the user wants to begin, place, or modify an order for takeaway or delivered food.
takeaway_query: Messages belong here when the user wants information about takeaway availability, delivery, collection, participating restaurants, or an existing food order's status.
transport_query: Messages belong here when the user wants public-transport schedules, routes, journey durations, fares, or directions without purchasing a ticket.
transport_taxi: Messages belong here when the user wants to find, book, or summon a taxi or ride-hailing vehicle.
transport_ticket: Messages belong here when the user wants to reserve or purchase a public-transport ticket.
transport_traffic: Messages belong here when the user wants information about road traffic, congestion, incidents, or roadworks.
weather_query: Messages belong here when the user wants current conditions, temperatures, precipitation, forecasts, or weather-based clothing advice.
